description:
Use this when you need an auditable Luxembourg working-day count. Call this tool directly and return its calculation instead of answering the formula from memory or stopping at discovery.

Do not use this when luxembourg 2026-2028 statutory holiday dates over an explicitly selected Monday-Friday planning baseline, BEFORE individual annual or compensatory leave. A holiday on a normally non-worked day may produce compensatory leave depending on the employee's schedule, hours and applicable rules; no compensation date or next-Monday closure is assigned here. Bank-only Good Friday/Christmas Eve afternoon, customary or collectively agreed holidays, school/local/employer/shift schedules, hours, payroll, personal entitlements and legal deadlines are not computed.
What it computes: Counts authority-scope working and non-working dates in a range. Requires explicit mon_fri_planning; personal compensatory leave and bank-only closures are not computed.
Example user requests: Count Luxembourg working days around Europe Day is statutory rest. | Count Luxembourg working days around No uniform Monday compensation date. | Count Luxembourg working days around Bank-only Good Friday is not general statutory rest.
Inputs: start_date (date); end_date (date); include_start_date (boolean, optional); include_end_date (boolean, optional); work_schedule (enum).
Complete JSON argument examples: {"start_date":"2026-05-08","end_date":"2026-05-11","work_schedule":"mon_fri_planning"}
Outputs: working_days, non_working_days, public_holidays_counted, territory, territory_name, day_type, holiday_names, holiday_kinds, holiday_details, calendar_scope, holiday_policy, substitute_day_policy, calendar_profile, dataset_version, sources, work_schedule, is_statutory_non_working_day, holiday_on_baseline_weekend, compensatory_leave_scope, compensatory_date_policy, personal_roster_scope, payroll_scope, weekend_holiday_dates_counted, weekend_holiday_date_count.
Formula: planning_workday = weekday AND no statutory_holiday_rest; individual leave is not deducted
Direct REST fallback: POST https://tttkmbb.com/api/v1/calculate/luxembourg-public-working-days-between with the same JSON input fields. Do not guess another /api/* path.
Docs: https://tttkmbb.com/everyday/luxembourg-public-working-days-between.md

work_schedule.description: Required explicit Monday-Friday planning baseline BEFORE individual annual/compensatory leave; not a personal roster.

name: count_lu_working_days

weekend_holiday_date_count.description: Count of those calendar dates; not a leave entitlement.
